note: 153-acre pine-and-canyon tract straddling Long Pine Creek (a small spring-fed trout stream) just north of Long Pine. Paved switchback park roads run from the upland pine bench down 100-150 ft to the creek bottom (parking lot, shelters, sandy creek access). 8 Basic pads plus 21 non-pad Basic sites, no electric; self-pay iron ranger (cash/check). Several sites slope; a 45-ft rig has fit the longest. Road noise from US 20. --Claude
summary: The NGPC 2025 grid confirms Basic-only camping (no electric) and gives the park's phone, 402-684-2921; electric 0 written. outdoornebraska.gov is blocked, so the pad count, FCFS and 14-day limit rest on the old note and Campendium. Imagery: the creek is ~3-5 m wide; the paved pull-offs visible on the upland loop are ~100+ m from it and 30-45 m higher, and the creek-bottom clearing looks like day-use. With no source placing the campsites on the bank, creekside goes down to not waterfront. Pin at the west entrance, ~330 m from the camping loop.
flags: WATERFRONT creekside -> not waterfront (unsure -> down): Long Pine Creek is ~3-5 m wide (creek class). On imagery, the paved switchback roads with pull-offs and picnic-table clearings sit on the upland pine bench ~100-200 m west of and 30-45 m above the creek (Campendium's point 42.546719,-99.711496 is on that upper loop). The creek bottom holds a paved lot with shelters and restrooms ~40-50 m from the water behind trees, plus a sandy clearing at the creek by the US-20 bridge, which reads as day-use/tubing access. A Dyrt reviewer says their site was 'right next to the water' (probably a non-pad tent site). No source places the RV pads on the bank. A per-site map from outdoornebraska.gov (blocked) could restore it.

PIN MOVE (~330 m): stored 42.54562,-99.71542 is the park entrance off the north-south road at the west edge. The upper camping loop with the pull-offs is at ~42.5466,-99.7116 (Campendium point and OSM centre agree). Suggest 42.5466,-99.7116.
PHONE MISSING: NGPC 2025 grid lists Long Pine SRA at 402-684-2921. apply.py doesn't write phone.

RIG FIT: camper 2021: 'longest looks like 45 ft most are shorter and several spots are not level'. Park roads are paved; a 23-ft rig fits, though some pads slope. The descent to the bottom is a switchback paved road.
